end.summary: Aarav ordered BCE and CE dates correctly on a timeline in 4 attempts.
end.parentNote: Asha practised ordering BCE/CE dates and identifying decades, centuries, and millennia. Aarav used the rule that larger BCE numbers are earlier and correctly placed 1947 in the 20th century. They were not yet able to work out the distance between BCE dates; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, draw a clear number line from 500 BCE to 200 BCE and practise counting the 300-year gap.
